item_short_desc: Get a brilliant, durable shine with KIWI Parade Gloss Shoe Polish. Specially formulated with a superior multi-wax blend, this shoe polish delivers a brighter and longer-lasting shine to your leather shoes. Its water-repellent properties help protect your shoes from moisture while ensuring they look polished and pristine for extended periods. KIWI Parade Gloss also helps to cover scuffs and minor blemishes, leaving your leather footwear with a mirror-like finish. Made in the USA, this high-quality shoe polish is trusted by professionals.
